boundaries: No native image was loaded and no native entry was executed for this review.
Existing r1 byte custody does not claim preservation of POSIX modes or timestamps.
Future failure-capture/mode additions are a separate source revision and are not covered by this exact hash.
Mutable private Python object replacement is outside the recorded byte-custody review.

findings.detail: _preserve_evidence executes only after all building/custody/loading succeeds; the BaseException handler immediately cleans the temporary build. An explicitly requested evidence export therefore does not retain raw failed bootstrap/build/loader attempts. No real native failure was manufactured or claimed.
findings.required_boundary: Failed attempts may be copied as BUILD_FAILED_RAW_ONLY with partial scope, while the exact original exception remains primary even if evidence writing or cleanup also fails. They cannot publish a successful fixture or qualification claim.

findings.detail: EVIDENCE_KEY is read only in _preserve_evidence on a cache miss and is absent from the fixture cache key. Selecting or changing an evidence destination after a warm fixture exists silently returns the fixture without exporting to that requested location.
findings.suggestion: Document and enforce first-build-only destination selection, or explicitly handle changed/late destinations on cache hits without recompiling or relabeling. Use a separate fresh evidence destination for each full-run child process.

verified_paths: Reject any nonempty proper five-manifest DEV selection and any DEV/COLD mixture before importing a builder or making files.
Resolve all supplied cold paths to one report; cold build failure propagates and never invokes the bootstrap-development branch.
Explicit 3/2/4/5-owner environment views clear all five ordinary selectors and all ten DEV/COLD keys before setting the intended owners.

Bootstrap freezes compiler and11source inputs, checks B0 source/artifact publication receipt, binds B1/B2 compiler/input/output receipts and exact fixed point, and rechecks all frozen sources/compiler before publication.
Before loading, every11image/source/manifest and owner dependency declaration is checked; loaded immutable image SHA must equal the pre-load disk declaration, then all custody pins are read again.
Cold cache also pins raw cold report, nested report, compiler and complete current_sources; every cache hit reruns check_custody.
Evidence export is explicitly development/cold-build scope and denies whole-stack qualification.
